title: You Asked For One Number And Paid For Sixteen
summary: Memory is sold by the cache line, not by the number. Write your own walk through an array and find the stride past which every read drags in a whole line and uses one element of it.

sources.title: Drepper, What Every Programmer Should Know About Memory
Hennessy and Patterson, Computer Architecture: A Quantitative Approach, appendix B on memory hierarchy
Mattson, Gecsei, Slutz and Traiger, Evaluation techniques for storage hierarchies (the stack property of LRU)
